definitions.gloss: sewing pattern; paper template for cutting fabric
definitions.explanation: A paper or cardboard template used as a guide for cutting fabric pieces when making clothes or other sewn items.

examples.japanese: {型紙|かたがみ}を{布|ぬの}に{当|あ}てる。
examples.english: I place the pattern on the fabric.

examples.japanese: {洋裁|ようさい}の{本|ほん}から{型紙|かたがみ}を{写|うつ}す。
examples.english: I copy the pattern from a sewing book.

examples.japanese: {型紙|かたがみ}に{沿|そ}って{布|ぬの}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: I cut the fabric along the pattern.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}で{型紙|かたがみ}を{作|つく}った。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{型|かた} (mold/pattern) + {紙|かみ} (paper) → {紙|がみ} (rendaku)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {型紙|かたがみ}を{写|うつ}す: trace a pattern
- {型紙|かたがみ}を{当|あ}てる: apply/place a pattern
- {型紙|かたがみ}に{沿|そ}って{切|き}る: cut along the pattern
- {型紙|かたがみ}{付|つ}き: with pattern included

TYPES:
- {実物大|じつぶつだい}{型紙|かたがみ}: full-size pattern
- {基本|きほん}{型紙|かたがみ}: basic pattern
- フリー{型紙|かたがみ}: free pattern (available online)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {洋裁|ようさい}: dressmaking
- {裁縫|さいほう}: sewing
- {布|ぬの}: fabric/cloth
- {縫|ぬ}い{代|しろ}: seam allowance
- {身頃|みごろ}: bodice (pattern piece)

NOTE:
{型紙|かたがみ} can also refer to traditional Japanese stencils used for dyeing fabric ({型染|かたぞ}め), though this meaning is less common in everyday usage.

COUNTER: {枚|まい}
